ideas.title: The Great Medicaid Heist: Uncovering the $11 Million Minnesota Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the suspect who fled before trial and the larger scheme behind the $11 million Medicaid fraud.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail and identify potential connections to other fraud cases.
questions: How did they get away with it?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a larger pattern of Medicaid fraud and potentially lead to more investigations.

ideas.title: The 'Age of Chaos' Report: A Deeper Look into Martin Weiss's Financial Claims
ideas.description: Investigate Martin Weiss's 'Age of Chaos' report and potential misleading financial information.
ideas.angle: Analyze the report's claims and determine if they are supported by evidence.
questions: Is there evidence to support them?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a larger issue with financial reporting and potentially lead to more investigations.
